  seam — the coordinator can't deliver a question, can't receive an escalation, and can't create a PR. Worth
  deciding whether the denial is intentional or an artifact worth a permission rule.

  The 04-ship.md gap is structural, not a one-off. cb-pr-check requires that file, and a conductor that dies at
  the ship gate never writes it — which is precisely the conductor most likely to have finished its work.
  Every such run needs a hand-synthesized ship record before it can be shipped. The natural fix is writing
  04-ship.md when the PR body is built (22:58 here) rather than after the GO, so the artifact exists before the
  pause that can kill the session.
